content_sections.heading: About TMC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Tata Memorial Centre, Mumbai, invites applications from Indian Nationals for positions in the Department of Anaesthesiology at Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital and Mahamana Pandit Madan Mohan Malaviya Cancer Centre, Varanasi. These positions are tenured based positions for a fixed period up to one year, further extendable subject to centre requirements.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The total number of advertised vacancies for the Department of Anaesthesiology is 5 posts. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? Test Yourself! 25 Questions · 20 Minutes · Instant Score Take Today's Free Quiz →

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: All Undergraduate, Postgraduate, and Super-Specialty degrees must be recognized by the National Medical Commission (NMC). It is mandatory for all candidates selected and appointed to HBCH/MPMMCC, Varanasi, to be registered with the Uttar Pradesh Medical Council, as applicable. Candidates whose results are awaited may apply, but they must produce proof of passing the required degree at the time of the MCQ/Interview.

rows.qualification_required: M.D. / D.N.B. (Anaesthesiology) or equivalent postgraduate degree recognized by NMC

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The advertised posts are tenured based positions for a fixed period of up to one year, which is further extendable subject to the requirements of the centre. Selected candidates are also required to pay a security/caution deposit as follows: Senior Resident I (Rs. 1,33,623/-), Senior Resident II (Rs. 1,36,269/-), Senior Resident III (Rs. 1,40,238/-), and Junior Resident III (Rs. 1,17,747/-).

rows.qualification_experience: M.D. / D.N.B. (Anaesthesiology) with 1 Year of experience
M.D. / D.N.B. (Anaesthesiology) with 2 years of experience

content_sections.heading: Age Limit and Relaxations
content_sections.text: The maximum age limit is 45 years , reckoned as on 06.11.2026.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application fee shall be paid online using a Debit Card, Credit Card, or UPI. The fee, once paid, is non-refundable under any circumstances.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process includes an MCQ Examination which may be conducted before the interview for shortlisting purposes. The Dean (Academics), HBCH/MPMMCC, Varanasi, holds the discretion to decide. The decision of the Dean (Academics), HBCH/MPMMCC, Varanasi, shall be final.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for TMC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official Tata Memorial Centre website: https://tmc.gov.in/postmaster/Careers Complete the online application form in all respects. Upload necessary documents, including proof of date of birth, qualifications, experience, caste/category, disability certificate, and NOC if employed. Pay the online application fee of Rs. 300/- via Debit/Credit Card or UPI. Submit the application form online on or before 06.11.2026 up to 05.30 p.m. Candidates are not required to submit or send a hard copy of the application form.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Proof of date of birth Educational qualification certificates and mark sheets Experience certificates Caste/category certificate (if applicable) Disability certificate (if applicable) No Objection Certificate (NOC) from current employer (if applicable) Proof of passing for candidates whose results were awaited during application

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates currently employed with Government or Government-related organizations must obtain a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer through the Head of their Institution/Department, upload it as part of the online application, and produce the original NOC at the time of the MCQ test/Interview. No TA/DA (Travel Allowance / Dearness Allowance) is admissible for candidates appearing for the MCQ test or interview. Incomplete applications or applications providing incorrect/false information will be summarily rejected. All correspondence with applicants will be made through the email ID [email protected] . Mandatory registration with the Uttar Pradesh Medical Council is required upon appointment.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for TMC Senior/Junior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of the online application is 06.11.2026 up to 05.30 p.m. (Indian Standard Time).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are advertised under Advt. No. VAR/ACA/45/2026?
faq.answer: A total of 5 vacancies are advertised for Senior Resident and Junior Resident posts in the Department of Anaesthesiology.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 45 years as on 06.11.2026, with relaxations applicable for SC, ST, OBC, and PwD candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for TMC Anaesthesiology recruitment?
faq.answer: The online application fee is Rs. 300/-, payable via Debit Card, Credit Card, or UPI.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.D. or D.N.B. in Anaesthesiology or an equivalent postgraduate degree recognized by the NMC.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is required for Junior Resident posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Diploma in Anaesthesiology.

faq.question: Q7. What is the monthly remuneration for Senior Resident III?
faq.answer: The monthly remuneration for Senior Resident III is Rs. 1,40,238/-.

faq.question: Q8. Is there an MCQ examination in the selection process?
faq.answer: Yes, an MCQ examination may be conducted before the interview for shortlisting purposes at the discretion of the Dean (Academics).

faq.question: Q9. Do employed candidates require an NOC?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates employed with Government or Government-related organizations must obtain, upload, and produce an original No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer.
